This is a different object from v15.41. v15.41 killed curvature–source correspondence on a linearized Cartan candidate whose holonomy was exactly zero. v15.42 certified a transport protocol without source adjudication. v15.43 applies that transport to response geometry and finds nonzero canonical response curvature. Source fitting is still banned. The next object named here — preregistered intrinsic-curvature interpretation without source fitting — is now on main as v15.44. Factorization with an explicit spectral boundary is on main as v15.45. Source correspondence remains NOT_EVALUATED.

Matching field note — not a selector

I start with nothing. Identities that can’t be erased. Rules for how they recombine. What survives is forced structure. Pairs look geometric. Three-way combinations produce an associator that won’t reduce to pairs. Not assumed geometry. Forced geometry. From what cannot be erased. It from bit, bind, and order.

Public voice of the research line. Not a derivation of Einstein, not a clock, not a gravity law. X is archive of record. GitHub is the freeze.

What this does not show

Einstein closed, derived, or ruled out. Einstein remains the effective fact in a retained world.
A physical affine connection, spacetime curvature, or stress-energy law.
Source correspondence. Explicitly NOT_EVALUATED.
Time, entropy, or a metric as primitives. Still pre-time.
A main-branch STATUS gate. Teaching v15.43 as the head of the geometry line after v15.45 is on main is a failure.
